invariants.rationale: The method assigns the value of 'bottom' to 'hScrollOnBottom', so they must be equal on method exit.
The method assigns the value of 'right' to 'vScrollOnRight', so they must be equal on method exit.
If both bottom and right are true, both hScrollOnBottom and vScrollOnRight are also true by assignment.
For any combination where at least one parameter is false, the assignments still ensure equality.
